Gather resources, master professions, and help rebuild the world. Play actively or at lower intensities, as you work towards big goals that can take months or even years. Choose what matters most to you across three parts of the game: your character, your settlement, and your empire. MASTER 12 PROFESSIONS AND BECOME THE TOWN’S GO-TO EXPERT Build your skills over months or years. Master your craft and become someone other players turn to for help. Gather materials, craft and upgrade tools, advance technology, and create the infrastructure your community needs through active and lower-attention gameplay. POWER UP AND UNLOCK YOUR NEXT BIG REWARD Develop your life skills through tasks, quests and challenges to unlock powerful rewards like mounts, boats and player housing! COLLECT RARE FINDS AND SHOW OFF YOUR STYLE Collect a wide range of cosmetics, outfits, pets, emotes, and rare decorations and other items to show off your style. Earn them through in-game goals or trade with other players. BUY, SELL, AND HAUL YOUR WAY TO A FORTUNE Buy, sell, or trade any item with other players. Help supply your settlement and earn money through your craft. Become a merchant and haul goods from one region to another to make a profit. Add storage, crafting stations, and decorations that give you boosts. Make it your base and a place to call home. FOUND A TOWN AND WATCH IT GROW WITH FRIENDS Work together with others to build towns and cities for all to visit, use, and live in. Make plans, split the work, and combine your skills to advance and upkeep your settlement, and civilizations that no player could easily build alone. FORM AN EMPIRE AND CLAIM YOUR CROWN Form an empire, recruit officers, and mark your territory. Crown yourself emperor and spread your name across the world for all to see. LEAVE YOUR MARK WITH BUILDS TOO BIG TO TACKLE ALONE Many hands make light work! Gather friends and strangers to construct player-imagined “megaprojects” which become permanent landmarks in the world. Key Features Shared World Join thousands of players in one lasting world, where towns and groups grow together. Active, Idle and Passive Gameplay Stay busy, take it slow, or make progress with less attention. Play at your own pace where long-term, horizontal progression shines. Play solo, with friends, or join established in-game towns and empires Play solo, team up with friends, or join a town or empire. Share supplies, split tasks, and combine your skills to build more than one player could easily make alone. Deep Crafting and Building Gather supplies, find rare items, and make and upgrade tools and gear. Go from a wanderer with nothing to a skilled crafter with a place in the world. Trade and Exchange Buy, sell, and exchange resources and crafted goods with other players. Support your settlement, find what you need, and make your profession part of a wider economy. A World You Can Reshape Terraform the land, open new routes, develop settlements, and leave your mark across Starfell. A Vast Land to Explore Travel through forests, rivers, mountains, and ancient ruins. Discover new resources, forgotten places, and opportunities far from home. Survival PvE Start with nothing, prepare for dangerous journeys, hunt wildlife, delve into ancient ruins with fierce enemies, and stay safe from the threats of the wild. An Evolving Story Take part in global events and watch the story of BitCraft unfold in a world shaped by its players with consistent updates expanding the ways you can play.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
BitCraft Online is a sandbox MMORPG set in a vast world shared by all players.

Begin with nothing in the ancient land of Starfell. Gather resources, master professions, and help rebuild the world. Play actively or at lower intensities, as you work towards big goals that can take months or even years.

Choose what matters most to you across three parts of the game: your character, your settlement, and your empire.

MASTER 12 PROFESSIONS AND BECOME THE TOWN’S GO-TO EXPERT

Build your skills over months or years. Master your craft and become someone other players turn to for help.

Gather materials, craft and upgrade tools, advance technology, and create the infrastructure your community needs through active and lower-attention gameplay.

POWER UP AND UNLOCK YOUR NEXT BIG REWARD

Develop your life skills through tasks, quests and challenges to unlock powerful rewards like mounts, boats and player housing!

COLLECT RARE FINDS AND SHOW OFF YOUR STYLE

Collect a wide range of cosmetics, outfits, pets, emotes, and rare decorations and other items to show off your style. Earn them through in-game goals or trade with other players.

BUY, SELL, AND HAUL YOUR WAY TO A FORTUNE

Buy, sell, or trade any item with other players. Help supply your settlement and earn money through your craft. Become a merchant and haul goods from one region to another to make a profit.

SHAPE THE WORLD, ONE ROAD OR MOUNTAIN AT A TIME

Terraform the land, pave roads, construct bridges, and set up lights. Open new travel routes and leave your mark across Starfell.

BUILD YOUR HOME AND MAKE ROOM FOR BIG DREAMS

Create a homestead solo or with friends or move into a house in an existing player-made town. Add storage, crafting stations, and decorations that give you boosts. Make it your base and a place to call home.

FOUND A TOWN AND WATCH IT GROW WITH FRIENDS

Work together with others to build towns and cities for all to visit, use, and live in. Make plans, split the work, and combine your skills to advance and upkeep your settlement, and civilizations that no player could easily build alone.

FORM AN EMPIRE AND CLAIM YOUR CROWN

Form an empire, recruit officers, and mark your territory. Crown yourself emperor and spread your name across the world for all to see.

LEAVE YOUR MARK WITH BUILDS TOO BIG TO TACKLE ALONE

Many hands make light work! Gather friends and strangers to construct player-imagined “megaprojects” which become permanent landmarks in the world.

Key Features

Shared World

Join thousands of players in one lasting world, where towns and groups grow together.

Active, Idle and Passive Gameplay

Stay busy, take it slow, or make progress with less attention. Play at your own pace where long-term, horizontal progression shines.

Play solo, with friends, or join established in-game towns and empires

Play solo, team up with friends, or join a town or empire. Share supplies, split tasks, and combine your skills to build more than one player could easily make alone.

Deep Crafting and Building

Gather supplies, find rare items, and make and upgrade tools and gear. Go from a wanderer with nothing to a skilled crafter with a place in the world.

Trade and Exchange

Buy, sell, and exchange resources and crafted goods with other players. Support your settlement, find what you need, and make your profession part of a wider economy.

A World You Can Reshape

Terraform the land, open new routes, develop settlements, and leave your mark across Starfell.

A Vast Land to Explore

Travel through forests, rivers, mountains, and ancient ruins. Discover new resources, forgotten places, and opportunities far from home.

Survival PvE

Start with nothing, prepare for dangerous journeys, hunt wildlife, delve into ancient ruins with fierce enemies, and stay safe from the threats of the wild.

An Evolving Story

Take part in global events and watch the story of BitCraft unfold in a world shaped by its players with consistent updates expanding the ways you can play.
